current_example.problem: What is the solution to the equation $0.25s=0.5?$
current_example.worked_solution:
First, we multiply both sides of the equation by $100$ to get rid of the decimals:

$$
\begin{aligned}0.25s & =0.5 \\ 100\cdot (0.25s) & =100\cdot (0.5) \\ 25s & =50\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve the equation using the multiplication principle, as usual:

$$
\begin{aligned}25s & =50 \\ \frac{25s}{25} & =\frac{50}{25} \\ \frac{\cancel{25}s}{\cancel{25}} & =\frac{50}{25} \\ s & =2\end{aligned}
$$
